text: smithay 0.7 DmabufState::create_global offers linux-dmabuf without feedback, and decade offers no wl_drm either, so a client's Mesa gets no DRM device (logs 'failed to get driver name for fd -1') and can fall back to software GL. ghostty then dropped its text above about 3000x1900 logical px. decade passes its render node as default feedback through render_node in src/compositor.rs.
